questions.text: Find the fourth proportional of 22, 66 and 11.

An article is sold at a discount of 25% and an additional discount of 28% is allowed on cash payment. If Ramendra purchased the article by paying ₹10,800 in cash, then what was the marked price of the article?
A shopkeeper marked the price as ₹15,000 on an article, and a successive discount of 5%, 10% and 20% was allowed on it. What is the selling price?
The value of a washing machine depreciated from ₹40,960 to ₹21,970 in 3 years. Find the yearly rate of depreciation.

A and B are equally efficient, and each can individually complete a piece of work in 36 days, if none takes any holiday. A and B started working together on this piece of work, but A took a day off after every five days of work, while B took a day off after every seven days of work. If the duo had started work on 1 July 2021, on which date was the work completed?

The radius of a metallic spherical ball is 3 cm. If the metallic ball is melted and recast into x number of hemispheres of radius equal to half the radius of the metallic spherical ball, then find the value of x.

Some ice pieces, spherical in shape, of diameter 6 cm are dropped in a cylindrical container containing some juice and are fully submerged. If the diameter of the container is 18 cm and level of juice rises by 40 cm, then how many ice pieces are dropped in the container?
If the slant height of a cone is 29 cm and its height is 20 cm, find the ratio between the magnitudes of total surface area and the volume.
In ∆ABC with sides 8 cm, 9 cm and 12 cm, the angle bisector of the largest angle divides the opposite sides into two segments. What is the length of the shorter segment?
If cot2θ = 1 - e2, then the value of cosec θ + cot3θ sec θ is:
A, B and C can do a piece of work in 11 days, 20 days and 55 days respectively. How soon can the work be done if A works with B on first day, A works with C on second day and so on?

A fast local of Mumbai takes 45 minutes less than a slow local for a journey of 150 km. If the speed of the fast local is 10 km/h more than that of the slow local, find the speed (in km/h) of the slow local train.

In a school of 720 students, the ratio of boys to girls is 3 : 5. Find how many new boys may be allowed to the school if 18 new girls are admitted, so that the ratio of boys to girls changes to 2 : 3.
The given graph shows the income and expenditure of a family. Study the graph and answer the question that follows. The expenditure of the family increased by _____ from 2017 to 2018.
Which of the following is the greatest four-digit number that is divisible by 15, 25, 40, and 75?
What is the average of the first six prime numbers?

Ayush spends 25% of an amount of money on an insurance policy, 26% on food, 23% on children’s education and 19% on recreation. He deposits the remaining amount of ₹26,600 in the bank. What is the total amount (in ₹) that he spends on food and recreation together?
Study the given pie-chart carefully and answer the question that follows. Degree wise Break-up of Expenditure of a Family in a Month What is the amount spent by the family on housing?
The number of balls, each one is 4 cm in the diameter that can be made from a solid metallic sphere of diameter 32 cm is:
Simplify the given expression. b + 2a - [(3b + a) - (2a + b) + 2a] - a

In a store, Arun has two options to buy a mobile phone, either he can pay the full amount of Rs.2,500 or he may buy at an instalment scheme, i.e. Rs.520 in down payment and four equal instalments, rate of interest being charged at 25% p.a. simple interest. Arun buys a mobile phone on the instalment scheme. What is the monthly instalment for Arun?
In a 1200 m race, Rakesh reaches the final point in 36 seconds and Rajesh reaches in 40 sec. By how much distance does Rakesh beat Rajesh?

Rakesh runs a coaching institute having 50 faculty members. The average monthly salary of 35 faculty members is ₹37,500. What will be the average monthly salary (in ₹) of the other 15 faculty members, if the average monthly salary of all the 50 faculty members is found to be ₹30,000?

Ankita sold three toys. The first toy was sold for ₹1,500 at a profit of 25%; the second toy was sold for ₹2,800 at a loss of 50% and the third toy was sold for ₹3,500 at a profit of 25%. Find her total profit or loss percentage.
Simplify the given expression. (x - 2y)(y - 3x) + (x + y)(x - y) + (x - 3y)(2x + y)
The least number of five digits which is exactly divisible by 9, 12, 15, 25 and 27 is:
The LCM of two numbers is five times their HCF. If the product of the two numbers is 20480,then find their HCF and LCM, respectively.
Find the HCF of 125, 250 and 750.
The LCM of 8, 12 and 18 is:
The ratio of monthly income and expenditure of a man is 7∶ 3. If his expenditure is ₹5,400, find his monthly income.
If 30% of Ravi’s income is equal to 40% of Suresh’s income, then 50% of Ravi’s income is equal to what percentage of Suresh’s income?
The chord of a circle is equal to its radius. Find the difference between the angle subtended by this chord at the minor arc and major arc of the circle.
The length of the common chord of two intersecting circles is 24 cm. If the diameter of the circles are 30 cm and 26 cm, then the distance between the centres (in cm) is:

Study the given table and answer the question that follows. The table shows the number of students in various courses in various cities A, B, C, D and E in India during the academic year 2022-2023. During the academic year 2022-2023, which city had the largest number of students?

Study the given bar graph carefully and answer the question that follows. Increment of four employees (in ₹) in the months of May, June and July. What is Kamal’s overall average increment in three months?
A hollow cylindrical tube made of plastic is 3 cm thick. If the external diameter is 20 cm and length of the tube is 49 cm, find the volume of the plastic.
The value of 2tan2 45° + cos2 30° - sin2 60° is:

A shopkeeper sells sugar at ₹40 per kg, which he purchased at ₹36 per kg. His weighing machine is faulty and it weighs only 800 gm while selling. His percentage profit (correct to 2 decimal places) is:
ΔPQR is right angled at Q such that PQ=(x-y),QR=x and PR=(x+y). S is a point on QR such that QS=PQ. The ratio QS∶ SR for any values of x and y is:

A man covers a certain distance by bike. If he covers 25% of the distance at the speed of 25 km/h, 50% of the distance at the speed of 50 km/h and the remaining distance at the speed of 12.5 km/h, find his average speed over the whole journey.
If the sum of two numbers is 60 and their HCF and LCM are 5 and 60, respectively, then the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers will be:
The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 9 and 126, respectively. Find the larger number, if the ratio between the numbers is 2 : 7.
